description: Demolition and redevelopment to provide two storey detached (5 bed) dwelling with habitable roof space
decision_conditions: Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no windows / doors, other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the flank elevations of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall be as stated in supporting documents.&nbsp;

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England)  Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no development which would otherwise fall within Classes A, B, D, E and F in Part 1 of Schedule 2 to that Order shall be carried out without the prior written permission of the local planning authority.
REASON: To safeguard the character of the area by restricting the amount of site coverage and size of dwelling in relation to the size of the plot and availability of:
a: amenity space
b: parking space
and to safeguard the amenity of neighbouring residents.

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;</p><p>01_000 - Rev.P1, 01_100B - Rev.P1, 01_101 - Rev.P1, 01_102 - Rev.P1, 01_000 - Rev.P1, 01_200 - Rev.P1, 01_202 - Rev.P1, 01_301 - Rev.P1, 03_000 - Rev.P1, 03_100 - Rev.P1, 03_100B - Rev.P1, 03_101 - Rev.P1, 03_102 - Rev.P1, 03_103 - Rev.P1, 03_201 - Rev.P1, 03_202 - Rev.P1, 03_203 - Rev.P1, 03_204 - Rev.P1, 03_205 - Rev.P1, 03_301 - Rev.P1, PRELIMINARY ECOLOGICAL ASSESSMENT, AWS ECOLOGY – SEPT 2026), Bat Emergence Survey Pro Hort Sept 2026), Design and Access Statement (Sept 2026), SuDS Strategy (Sept 2026), CIL Forms 1 &amp; 7&nbsp;</p>

Evidence of certification of Secure by Design Accreditation for the development shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority in writing for approval before any part of the development is occupied or used. The development shall only be completed and operated in accordance with any approval.
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p>The windows in the flank elevations of the proposed development shall:
</p><p>(a) be of purpose-made obscure glass,
</p><p>(b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level,
and shall thereafter be retained in that form.</p>

<p>Prior to the commencement of construction, a scale, colour plan of biodiversity enhancements on the site, to include the number, specification, and location of enhancements such as bat and bird boxes, and photo evidence of the removal of invasive plant species, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Thereafter, the biodiversity enhancement measures shall be carried out and retained in accordance with the approved details.&nbsp;</p>

<p>Precautionary Working Method Statement</p><p>No development shall take place (including vegetation/site clearance) until a Precautionary Working Method Statement (PWMS) for protected species has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The PWMS should include, but may not be limited to;</p><p>i.<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>A toolbox talk covering the ecology of and legislation which protects species which may be present on site, to be delivered to construction personnel by the ECoW;</p><p>ii.<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>A plan showing areas of sensitivity and exclusion zones;</p><p>iii.<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Details of where and how waste and/or construction materials will be stored;</p><p>iv.<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Details of mitigation measures required for protected species, such as herptile fencing;</p><p>v.<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Details of which construction tasks pose a risk to protected species, and will therefore be supervised by the ECoW;</p><p>vi.<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Measures for supervised vegetation clearance (e.g., phased, directional cut);</p><p>vii.<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Guidance on sensitive roof strip techniques; and</p><p>viii.<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Procedures to be followed if a protected species is discovered.</p><p>The approved PWMS shall be implemented in full according to the specified timescales, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.</p><div><br></div>

<p>The development hereby permitted (other than demolition works) shall not be commenced until works for the disposal of sewage have been provided on site in accordance with details to be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority. The works shall thereafter be retained. To ensure that the necessary construction and design criteria for the development proposals follow approved conditions. The applicant should contact Thames Water Utilities Limited and the Harrow Infrastructure Team at the earliest opportunity.&nbsp;</p>

<p>No external lighting shall be installed on the development hereby permitted unless full details of a lighting scheme are submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The scheme shall include details of the exact location, height, design, and intensity of the lights, and shall be designed in accordance with the Guidance Note on Bats &amp; Artificial Lighting [link], to prevent light spillage onto nearby habitat suitable for bats. The lighting shall be installed and operated strictly in accordance with the approved details.&nbsp;</p>

<p>Landscaping Scheme, including a Landscape Masterplan and detailed hard and soft landscape proposals.&nbsp;</p><p>• Soft landscaping details, including:- Planting plans (minimum scale 1:100);- Plant schedules specifying species, sizes, container sizes at the time of planting, and planting densities;- Written specification for planting and cultivation works; and- A landscape implementation and phasing programme.</p><p>• Details of all hard surfacing materials.</p><p>• Boundary treatment details.</p><p>• Details of secure and screened bin and cycle storage.</p><p>• Existing and proposed site levels.</p><p>• Landscaping implementation, including replacement of any trees or plants that fail, die or become seriously damaged within five years of planting.&nbsp;</p>

<p>&nbsp;Construction Management Plan Condition</p><p>Prior to the commencement of development, a Construction Management Plan (CMP) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The CMP shall include details of construction vehicle routing, site access arrangements, contractor parking, loading and unloading of materials, site compound locations, dust suppression measures, noise and vibration control, hours of construction, and wheel washing facilities. The development shall thereafter be carried out in accordance with the approved Construction Management Plan for the duration of the construction works.</p>

<p><span style="font-size: 14px;">Prior to the first occupation of the dwelling, details of the provision for the storage and collection of refuse and recyclable materials shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved scheme shall demonstrate the location, size, design and accessibility of the refuse and recycling storage area, including arrangements for collection, and shall be implemented in full prior to first occupation of the development and retained thereafter.</span></p>

<p>Flood Risk, Drainage and Evacuation Plan&nbsp;</p><p>Prior to the commencement of development (excluding demolition and site clearance), a detailed surface water drainage scheme, foul drainage scheme, and Flood Evacuation Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The submitted details shall include:</p><p>a) Confirmation of the required surface water attenuation volume and details demonstrating that sufficient on</p><p>site storage capacity is provided to accommodate all surface water runoff generated by the development;</p><p>b) Detailed design drawings, calculations and specifications for all Sustainable Drainage Systems (SuDS),</p><p>attenuation features and discharge arrangements;</p><p>c) Full details of the proposed separate foul water drainage system;</p><p>d) A Flood Evacuation Plan, including emergency planning measures, safe access and egress arrangements,</p><p>and details of a safe evacuation route away from the source of flooding. The evacuation route shall be clearly</p><p>identified on an appropriately scaled plan;</p><p>e) Details of the future management, maintenance and operation of all drainage infrastructure for the lifetime of the development.</p><p>The approved measures shall be implemented in full prior to the first occupation of the development and shall thereafter be retained and maintained in accordance with the approved details.</p>
